il_police_crime_records.notes: The source is one row per criminal case file (FictiveIDNumber) with year, quarter, area codes and offence type. Values here are the number of case-file rows per area, year (and quarter) and offence type, counted from the downloaded records (raw/crime_records_homicide_types_2021_2025.json); they count case files, not victims. Offence types kept: 301 murder, 302 murder by hostile act (terrorism), 303 attempted murder, 305 manslaughter. Not kept: 307 causing death by negligence, 309 'other offences against human life'. 2023 murder files (1,209) include the 7 October 2023 attack, which the police recorded as murder case files. 801 of 3,122 records have no police district and 1,516 no locality; they are counted only at the levels that are filled. 4 records have district 'כל הארץ' (whole country). Counts in 2021-2022 are much lower than in later years; the dataset's offence list has a sensitivity flag and some records may be withheld - the source does not explain.
